entries.final_answer: CI runs on GitHub-hosted ubuntu-24.04 runners and installs @spec-kitty/* with a read:packages classic PAT stored as the repo secret NPM_TOKEN (same kind as QA_NPM_TOKEN). The repo .npmrc holds only the scope mapping; local builds use the developer's own ~/.npmrc token.
options: GITHUB_TOKEN with this repo granted Actions access on each package
Org secret holding a read:packages PAT
